brief.zh: 巡查员只需要高温记录的编号和温度。把最热的排在最前面。
brief.en: The inspector only needs ID and temperature for the warm readings. Put the hottest one first.

concept.zh: 同时组合列选择、两条筛选条件和降序排列。
concept.en: Combine a column projection, two row conditions, and descending order.

hints.zh: 先定车间和 28°C 下限，再找从大到小的排序选项。
hints.en: Select workshop and a 28°C minimum first. Then find the highest-to-lowest sort option.

prompt.zh: 输出车间至少 28°C 的记录，只显示编号和温度，并从最高温度排到最低。
prompt.en: Return workshop readings of at least 28°C. Show only ID and temperature, hottest first.
